research_contract.phase_rule: rank on median excess Sharpe over every rebalance phase

limitations: The universe is the 2026-07-23 survivor cross-section; delisted, historical ST, and names that left the universe are absent.
Prices are forward-adjusted and share volume is not adjusted consistently; amount and ADV are OHLC-average times volume proxies.
No point-in-time industry, free-float market-cap, ST, corporate-action, or limit-lock state is available.
A missing entry or exit open is frozen at zero return and is not replaced using future information; this is conservative but not a full suspension ledger.
The 2025+ split has been viewed by earlier research and is retrospective confirmation, not a never-observed external holdout.
Historical trial count before this artifact is not provably complete, so promotion remains fail-closed even if this batch passes its local correction.
This engine is a technical research diagnostic and is not an independently admitted authoritative backtest record.
